Menu_Onboarding_Page6_A2: Roblox has implemented an FFlag allowlist, which blocks the use of most FFlags. This was done to prevent people from using exploitable flags and to avoid FFlags that could cause bugs. You can view the allowlist [here](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/allowlist-for-local-client-configuration-via-fast-flags/3966569).
Menu_Onboarding_Page6_A3: You likely enabled the Pause Voxelizer FFlag (DFFlagDebugPauseVoxelizer). Disable it to fix the issue.
Menu_Onboarding_Page6_A4: Delete RobloxCookies.dat inside %localappdata%\Roblox\LocalStorage, which should fix the issue the majority of the time. We currently do not know what causes this issue.

Uninstaller_Text:
Afinstallationen fjerner Froststrap fra dit system og konfigurerer automatisk standard-Roblox-launcheren på ny, hvis den stadig er installeret.

Hvis du afinstallerer eller geninstallerer, fordi du har problemer med Roblox, skal du først læse [denne hjælpeside]({0}).

Afinstallationsprocessen kan muligvis ikke rydde helt op efter sig selv, så du skal muligvis manuelt rydde op i resterende filer der, hvor Froststrap var installeret.
